Revenue Operations Analyst (Co-op)
Fernwood Software · Kitchener, ON · Hybrid

About the job

Fernwood Software is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst (Co-op) to support our go-to-market
teams. This is a hybrid role based out of our Kitchener office, with two days per week
on-site.

Responsibilities
• Maintain territory and quota planning models
• Support deal desk operations and pipeline management reporting
• Partner with sales operations on forecasting accuracy

Qualifications
• Currently enrolled in a business, commerce, or analytics program
• Strong Excel skills; SQL exposure is an asset

Term: Summer 2027 (4 months)
Pay rate: $27.00 per hour

Applications close 2027-02-28.

Fernwood Software is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants
without regard to race, religion, or any other protected status.
